label: Floating Data Pills
description: Data made physical: chips drifting in faux-3D. ORBIT (a big box over a hero stat or headline): chips scatter round the centre and keep clear of the scene's type, measured once every component is built. STRIP (a wide, short box, e.g. a band under a speaker): chips sit in one or two jittered rows -- the 'too many tools' look. Chips are sized from the box, never overlap each other, never leave the frame. 3-12 items.

items.label: Chip labels, e.g. ["+340 h", "+128 h"] or tool names; 3-12

font_size.label: Chip text size floor (the size comes from the slot; a smaller value is ignored)

scale.label: Size multiplier on the slot-derived size

layout.label: orbit | strip (default: strip when the box is wider than ~3:1)
